ITEM 1 | Dark green crinkled leaves with pale green-white stems and a few red-purple vein stems, wilted and glossy, spread across the right half of the plate, roughly 40% of plate footprint, about 1 cm thick in heaps | 90
ITEM 2 | Bright green floret cluster with dense knobby tops and thick pale stalk, matte and moist, about 5 cm across, on the left side of the plate, sitting beside pale cauliflower | 60
ITEM 3 | Pale cream-yellow cauliflower florets with slightly browned edges, soft and matte, two clusters about 3 cm each, next to the broccoli | 45
ITEM 4 | Small olive-green Brussels sprouts, halved or whole, some with browned outer leaves, glossy and firm, about 2-3 cm each, scattered in the center among the greens | 40
ITEM 5 | Diced orange carrot pieces, about 1 cm cubes, matte and slightly moist, scattered on top of and beside the leaves | 8
ITEM 6 | Flaky pinkish-orange fish fillet with golden-brown crusted coating and herb flecks, moist and tender-looking, about 6 x 4 cm and 1.5 cm thick, with a darker grey-brown skin piece on one edge, at lower right | 85
ITEM 7 | Thin smear of pale green sauce with a red-purple stem piece, glossy and semi-liquid, about 8 x 2 cm strip beneath the broccoli | 10
